column5: When a capability lands, the commit MUST update the doctrine line that forbade it — a rule stating a limitation is a claim about the code and goes stale like any other. Ban bare do-NOT-re-test clauses in memories: pin them to the commit/date they measured so a later capability invalidates them visibly. Rule of thumb: a doctrine line asserting we CANNOT do X must cite the file:line that makes it true, so the citation breaks when X ships.
